game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon, a canyon of scorpions: the caravan guide must hold off vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon: a canyon of scorpions
core_gameplay_loop: In Scorpion Canyon, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Then check clean_score and advance.
player_objective: Protect the palm grove from vultures in Scorpion Canyon: keep clean_score above zero until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 8 (extended tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 8, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

learning_objectives: Understand the idea behind: Debugging & Combined Skills
Apply “Refactor Rescue” in a short challenge
Predict what the code does before running it
Notice and fix a mistake in the code

ui.title: Scorpion Canyon: Refactor Rescue
ui.subtitle: Hold out until the timer ends!

then: add_event_log('That choice does not match the code.')

hint: Read the code panel: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Keep clean_score above zero until the timer reaches 71.

tutorial.message: Vultures are coming! Watch the clean_score meter.
Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Look at the code: def f():
Survive for 71 seconds to complete the level.

on_win.title: Level Cleared!
on_win.message: You mastered Refactor Rescue in Sand Dunes!

on_lose.title: Try Again!
on_lose.message: clean_score ran out. Fix the code sooner and watch the meter!
